title: Correct coefficient of kinetic friction
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be μ = 0.5.

title: Correct magnetic induction intensity
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be B' = 10 T.

title: Ampere force resolution
description: Important: The student must correctly resolve the Ampere force into components parallel (causing friction) and perpendicular (affecting normal force) to the rail plane.

title: Normal force calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the normal force, accounting for the vertical component of the Ampere force subtracting from or adding to the weight.

title: Force balance setup
description: Important: The student must apply static equilibrium conditions (sum of forces = 0) for both the initial and the 'about to move' scenarios.

title: Friction model application
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the kinetic friction model (F_f = μ F_N) for part (1) and the maximum static friction model (F_f' = μ F_N') for part (2).

title: Sign error in normal force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses the same sign for the Ampere force's vertical component in both scenarios, failing to account for its reversal when the magnetic field is reversed.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's working should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (kg, m, s, A, T, N).
